description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableSortOption class, verifying immutability, equality, string representation, and collection behaviors.

classes.name: ImmutableSortOptionTest
classes.description: A final class containing unit tests for ImmutableSortOption, testing aspects like immutability, equality, string outputs, and collection behaviors.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ImmutableSortOption is immutable and that its entries are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableSortOption correctly implements hashCode and equals methods.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewInstanceWithNullEntries
methods.description: Ensures that creating an ImmutableSortOption with null entries throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: stringRepresentationOfZeroEntriesIsExpected
methods.description: Checks that an ImmutableSortOption with no entries has an empty string representation.

methods.name: stringRepresentationIsExpected
methods.description: Verifies the string output of ImmutableSortOption with multiple entries.

methods.name: sortOptionWithoutEntriesIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks that an ImmutableSortOption with no entries reports zero size and is empty.

methods.name: getEntriesReturnsAnUnmodifiableCollection
methods.description: Confirms that the collection returned by getEntries() is unmodifiable and throws an exception if modification is attempted.
